situation: Junior on my team, Nadia, handled a tense client call today really well. Client pushed hard on the delay and she kept it calm. Want to tell her on Slack.
reply: Nadia, the way you handled the Brightwell call today was great. When they pushed on the delay, you gave them the new date and the reason in two sentences and they settled right down. I'm borrowing that.

situation: 领导王总在部门群里夸我这次展会方案做得好，其实是我和小周一起做的。怎么回比较得体？
reply: 谢谢王总！这次确实花了不少心思，看到效果挺开心的。物料和现场流程小周出了很多力，这份功劳有她一半。
note: 先大方接住，再提同事，不要一上来就说"没有没有，都是大家的功劳"。

situation: I'm a contractor redoing a client's kitchen. He keeps texting stuff like 'you look great in those overalls ha'. I want to shut it down but keep the job.
reply: I'd rather keep things to the project, thanks. Speaking of which, countertop templating is booked for Thursday at 9.
note: Plain, short and back to the work. If it happens again, say it once more and keep a record of the messages.
